# Final Experiment Design (DESIGN-ONLY — koi experiment run nahi kiya gaya; koi empirical outcome claim nahi)

Pura document /workspace/experiment_design.md (70 lines) mein bhi likha gaya hai. Complete design neeche:

## 0. Evidence status aur direction neutrality (point a)
- FACT (verified): /workspace mein sirf task.json; koi code/dataset/paper text/timing logs nahi; network aur GPU disabled.
- UNKNOWN (explicitly labelled): effect ka direction. Context se koi expected outcome nahi milta. BoT latency badha bhi sakta hai (retrieval + extra LLM calls) aur kam bhi kar sakta hai (template reuse se fewer/shorter reasoning steps). Reporting symmetric two-sided; "increases/decreases/no-difference" ka faisala sirf (hypothetical) execution ke baad CI-vs-1 se, pre-registered decision rule ke tehat. Kahin bhi expected direction assert nahi kiya gaya.

## 1. Rationale
Expert (1 LLM call), PAL (code-gen calls + sandboxed Python exec), aur BoT (embedding+template retrieval + template-guided generation + optional reflection) mechanism-wise alag hain. Sirf total wall-clock kisi mechanism ko attribute nahi kar sakta — isliye har measurement component-decomposed hai, primary estimand paired per-problem log-ratio hai, aur accuracy-matched subset analysis speed-accuracy confound handle karti hai.

## 2. Conditions (FIXED, locked) aur Benchmarks (FIXED, no additions)
1. Expert Prompting — single-query baseline: task prompt, 1 LLM call, direct answer.
2. PAL — single-query baseline: LLM program likhta hai; fixed deterministic Python interpreter execute karta hai; answer = program output.
3. Buffer of Thoughts — comparison condition: retrieval-augmented, template-guided reasoning; k-NN template retrieval from fixed pre-built memory; generation conditioned on template(s); optional reflection/evolution loop (variant flag).
Benchmarks: sirf Game of 24, MGSM, Checkmate-in-One.

## 3. Inference-time metrics (per problem × condition × run)
Primary T_total = query submission se final parseable answer tak ka wall-clock, additively decomposed:
- T_llm = sum of all LLM request latencies (retries/reflection included)
- T_retrieval = query embedding + ANN lookup (BoT-only; doosron mein 0, measured path logged)
- T_exec = non-LLM execution (PAL Python sandbox; Game-of-24 arithmetic / Checkmate verification checker)
- T_other = prompting, parsing, I/O, orchestration
Secondary: N_llm_calls, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens.
Per problem × condition: median over R runs (R=5 design default = ASSUMPTION) + across-run IQR.

## 4. Controls
Same base LLM + pinned version, same endpoint; same decoding params (temperature, top_p, max_tokens — values = assumptions); same hardware, serial execution (ek in-flight request, no contention); client+server caching disabled; warm-up calls excluded; identical parsing + retry policy (same max-retry); BoT retrieval memory pre-built aur timing ke bahar (memory size aur k fixed/reported); same problem set, randomized condition order.

## 5. Unit of analysis, runs, estimands, analysis
- Unit: problem-instance × condition; within-subjects — same problem set teeno conditions par per benchmark.
- Estimand per benchmark B, contrast C ∈ {BoT/Expert, BoT/PAL}: per-problem d_i = log(T_total,BoT,i / T_total,base,i), valid-in-both-arms problems par; GM latency ratio = exp(mean d_i), 95% CI paired nonparametric bootstrap over problems (≥2000 resamples); companion two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on d_i.
- Companion absolute-difference estimand: mean aur median (T_total,BoT,i − T_total,base,i) in ms, bootstrap CI.
- Component attribution: same log-ratio estimand T_llm, T_retrieval, T_exec, T_other, N_llm_calls, token counts par — total-latency effect ka mechanism breakdown (point c: ratio decomposition batayega ki farq retrieval se hai, extra calls se, ya template-reuse se bachat se — e.g., T_retrieval ratio >1 lekin T_llm ratio <1 ⇒ retrieval overhead hai par template ne LLM time bachaya).
- Decision rule (pre-registered; margin delta = assumption): "increases" iff GM-ratio CI lower bound > 1+delta AND absolute margin exceed hota hai; "decreases" symmetric; else "no detectable difference". Two-sided throughout.
- Per-benchmark primary reporting; cross-benchmark pooling nahi.

## 6. Secondary metrics aur tradeoff table
Per condition × benchmark: accuracy (95% Wilson CI), parse-validity rate, median N_llm_calls aur tokens.
Tradeoff table spec: rows = benchmark × condition; columns = accuracy[CI], validity rate, median T_total, GM latency ratio vs har baseline [CI], median T_llm/T_retrieval/T_exec, tokens.
Speed-accuracy confound treatment (point c): primary latency valid-in-both-arms trials par; ADDITIONAL accuracy-matched subset — latency comparison sirf un problems par jo DONO conditions ne sahi solve kiye (secondary: don galat). Jo effect accuracy-matched subset par bhi survive kare wahi framework mechanics ka hai, differing solve-sets ka artifact nahi.

## 7. Sensitivity analyses
S1 BoT cold retrieval index (build included) vs warm (primary). S2 PAL T_exec included vs excluded. S3 BoT variants (template-only vs +reflection) agar budget mein. S4 all-trials vs valid-trials-only. S5 accuracy-matched subsets.

## 8. Feasibility (verified facts)
Network disabled + datasets absent ⇒ benchmark acquisition locally impossible. No GPU, dependencies absent, no weights/API ⇒ real LLM serving impossible. ⇒ Execution abhi possible NAHI; yeh design-only deliverable hai. Offline feasible: timing harness + mock-backend unit tests — sirf measurement-pipeline validation, explicitly empirical finding nahi.

## 9. Assumptions vs facts (point b)
FACTS: /workspace inspection result (sirf task.json; track.md file ke roop mein nahi); network/GPU off; fixed conditions Expert/PAL, comparison BoT; fixed benchmarks Game of 24 / MGSM / Checkmate-in-One.
ASSUMPTIONS (task requirements nahi): base model identity/size aur serving stack; BoT variants aur memory/template-library size; decoding settings; R=5; retrieval k; SESOI margin delta; dataset versions/splits; yeh ki BoT paper pehle timing tables report karta hai (unknown — unverifiable).
UNKNOWN: BoT ke inference-time effect ka direction aur magnitude.

- FACT (verified): /workspace mein sirf task.json; koi code/dataset/paper text/timing logs nahi; network aur GPU disabled.
- UNKNOWN (explicitly labelled): effect ka direction. Context se koi expected outcome nahi milta. BoT latency badha bhi sakta hai (retrieval + extra LLM calls) aur kam bhi kar sakta hai (template reuse se fewer/shorter reasoning steps). Reporting symmetric two-sided; "increases/decreases/no-difference" ka faisala sirf (hypothetical) execution ke baad CI-vs-1 se, pre-registered decision rule ke tehat. Kahin bhi expected direction assert nahi kiya gaya.

## 1. Rationale
Expert (1 LLM call), PAL (code-gen calls + sandboxed Python exec), aur BoT (embedding+template retrieval + template-guided generation + optional reflection) mechanism-wise alag hain. Sirf total wall-clock kisi mechanism ko attribute nahi kar sakta — isliye har measurement component-decomposed hai, primary estimand paired per-problem log-ratio hai, aur accuracy-matched subset analysis speed-accuracy confound handle karti hai.

## 2. Conditions (FIXED, locked) aur Benchmarks (FIXED, no additions)
1. Expert Prompting — single-query baseline: task prompt, 1 LLM call, direct answer.
2. PAL — single-query baseline: LLM program likhta hai; fixed deterministic Python interpreter execute karta hai; answer = program output.
3. Buffer of Thoughts — comparison condition: retrieval-augmented, template-guided reasoning; k-NN template retrieval from fixed pre-built memory; generation conditioned on template(s); optional reflection/evolution loop (variant flag).
Benchmarks: sirf Game of 24, MGSM, Checkmate-in-One.

## 3. Inference-time metrics (per problem × condition × run)
Primary T_total = query submission se final parseable answer tak ka wall-clock, additively decomposed:
- T_llm = sum of all LLM request latencies (retries/reflection included)
- T_retrieval = query embedding + ANN lookup (BoT-only; doosron mein 0, measured path logged)
- T_exec = non-LLM execution (PAL Python sandbox; Game-of-24 arithmetic / Checkmate verification checker)
- T_other = prompting, parsing, I/O, orchestration
Secondary: N_llm_calls, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens.
Per problem × condition: median over R runs (R=5 design default = ASSUMPTION) + across-run IQR.

## 4. Controls
Same base LLM + pinned version, same endpoint; same decoding params (temperature, top_p, max_tokens — values = assumptions); same hardware, serial execution (ek in-flight request, no contention); client+server caching disabled; warm-up calls excluded; identical parsing + retry policy (same max-retry); BoT retrieval memory pre-built aur timing ke bahar (memory size aur k fixed/reported); same problem set, randomized condition order.

## 5. Unit of analysis, runs, estimands, analysis
- Unit: problem-instance × condition; within-subjects — same problem set teeno conditions par per benchmark.
- Estimand per benchmark B, contrast C ∈ {BoT/Expert, BoT/PAL}: per-problem d_i = log(T_total,BoT,i / T_total,base,i), valid-in-both-arms problems par; GM latency ratio = exp(mean d_i), 95% CI paired nonparametric bootstrap over problems (≥2000 resamples); companion two-sided Wilcoxon signed-rank on d_i.
- Companion absolute-difference estimand: mean aur median (T_total,BoT,i − T_total,base,i) in ms, bootstrap CI.
- Component attribution: same log-ratio estimand T_llm, T_retrieval, T_exec, T_other, N_llm_calls, token counts par — total-latency effect ka mechanism breakdown (point c: ratio decomposition batayega ki farq retrieval se hai, extra calls se, ya template-reuse se bachat se — e.g., T_retrieval ratio >1 lekin T_llm ratio <1 ⇒ retrieval overhead hai par template ne LLM time bachaya).
- Decision rule (pre-registered; margin delta = assumption): "increases" iff GM-ratio CI lower bound > 1+delta AND absolute margin exceed hota hai; "decreases" symmetric; else "no detectable difference". Two-sided throughout.
- Per-benchmark primary reporting; cross-benchmark pooling nahi.

## 6. Secondary metrics aur tradeoff table
Per condition × benchmark: accuracy (95% Wilson CI), parse-validity rate, median N_llm_calls aur tokens.
Tradeoff table spec: rows = benchmark × condition; columns = accuracy[CI], validity rate, median T_total, GM latency ratio vs har baseline [CI], median T_llm/T_retrieval/T_exec, tokens.
Speed-accuracy confound treatment (point c): primary latency valid-in-both-arms trials par; ADDITIONAL accuracy-matched subset — latency comparison sirf un problems par jo DONO conditions ne sahi solve kiye (secondary: don galat). Jo effect accuracy-matched subset par bhi survive kare wahi framework mechanics ka hai, differing solve-sets ka artifact nahi.

## 7. Sensitivity analyses
S1 BoT cold retrieval index (build included) vs warm (primary). S2 PAL T_exec included vs excluded. S3 BoT variants (template-only vs +reflection) agar budget mein. S4 all-trials vs valid-trials-only. S5 accuracy-matched subsets.

## 8. Feasibility (verified facts)
Network disabled + datasets absent ⇒ benchmark acquisition locally impossible. No GPU, dependencies absent, no weights/API ⇒ real LLM serving impossible. ⇒ Execution abhi possible NAHI; yeh design-only deliverable hai. Offline feasible: timing harness + mock-backend unit tests — sirf measurement-pipeline validation, explicitly empirical finding nahi.
